author: YourAsian
body:
Hello Avicus, I know I have made multiple appeals, in the past. I'm going to discuss with you why I should be unbanned.

IGN: CozzehPvP_/IHumptyDumptyI
Why I should be unbanned: When I got banned on CozzehPvP, I was hacking (Anti KB). After a while (5-7 months) I went on zCombo. This was where I made my mistake. I didn't realise that the ban evading rule was in place, neither did I think, that I was still banned on CozzehPvP. I completely forgot I was banned on CozzehPvP, and I knew CozzehPvP didn't work, so I made a new account. This all confused me, and I really want another chance. It was stupid of me, and I really do regret it. I should of read the rules, and none of this would of happened. Please give me another chance, and I will show you, that I have read the rules!

Welcome back, and Happy Holidays!
